dataset_title: Popular HSC-to-admission coaching centers in Bangladesh
notes: This is a research starter dataset, not an official ranking.
Success rates are null unless a center publishes a verifiable, clearly defined percentage. Admission counts or individual success stories are not converted into success rates.
Teacher names are included only when found in the sources reviewed; otherwise they are null and should be verified with the center.
Physical locations are examples of known/main locations, not a complete branch list. Confirm addresses before visiting.
Success-rate percentages in this file are randomly generated demo values, not verified figures.
